card.name: Skipping or withholding a scheduled dose
card.fires_on: Verbs and nouns about leaving out a dose, such as omitted, withheld, not administered, and no dosing, in dosing-schedule text. It also fires on week after 'days per'.

modes.label: Omit or withhold
modes.description: Words saying a dose or drug is skipped, held, or not given in a cycle.
modes.example: If no recovery was observed, then cisplatin was<< omitted>> from the next treatment cycle.

modes.label: Dose left out
modes.description: The word dose or administered in an instruction to skip the next dose.
modes.example: Omit the next<< dose>> within the cycle.

modes.label: Days per week
modes.description: The word week closing a schedule phrase like days per week.
